attributes.name: Wenduag
attributes.powers:
The difficulty of the check to defeat Wenduag is equal to 1 plus the highest difficulty to defeat a random monster from the box.

Before you act, Wenduag deals 1 Ranged combat damage to you and a random other character at your location.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
